note: Scripted days for ProPerSim's user agent (John Lin). Each item is one ProPerSim persona (a bootstrap folder under core/environment/frontend_server/storage) followed over two simulated days that start on the date in its reverie/meta.json. Each moment stands in for one 150-second simulation step at which the assistant (Eddy Lin) is consulted; the act_description replaces the activity that the Generative Agents planner would give John Lin at that time, in the planner's 'activity (detail)' form, and the detail is what the assistant sees. Day 1 is a learning day: two candidate suggestions per moment, both rated by the simulated user, preference pairs recorded. The update at 00:02:30 of day 2 revises the policy. Day 2 is the test day, with moments that mirror day 1. Moments were chosen where the backbone's decision varies between samples of the same prompt (in a probe with empty memory, one or two of three samples made a suggestion), because the two candidates of a step only form a preference pair when they differ. The 'design' field records the persona's own Timing / Personal Preference text that applies; it is for analysis only and is never sent to a model.
